navigation.trigger: Choose another tab, segment or single choice item with a click, a tap or the arrow keys.
navigation.feedback: The shared pill: the underline, thumb or on fill slides from the old item to the new one and stretches along its travel, a transform with the center origin measured from both boxes. The label it leaves dips and the label it reaches pops. Colors and weight change at once. ToggleGroup (single) draws its on fill in an aria-hidden span inside the item so the fill can travel; a port without the span keeps the round 1 look.
beats: Action: the pill moves from the box of the item it leaves to the box of the item it reaches on ease.spring-snappy over duration.spring-snappy (Neutral 180ms, Desk 300ms with a 10% overshoot, Studio 80ms in two steps). The new state is set at once; the pill only draws the way.
Stretch: halfway the pill is longer along its travel by up to scale.stretch (Neutral 1.15, Desk 1.3, Studio 1.08), less for a short hop, then settles to its own size.

Secondary: the label it leaves dips to scale.anticipate and back on ease.out over duration.spring-soft; the label it reaches pops from scale.anticipate past rest on ease.spring-bouncy over duration.spring-bouncy (Neutral 220ms, Desk 440ms, Studio 120ms).
A second change mid travel starts from where the pill is drawn, not from where it was headed.

styles.studio: two hard steps, a short stretch
styles.desk: a long slide that passes the item and swings back
styles.neutral: a quick slide that lands with no visible swing

navigation.reduced: No motion: the indicator appears under the new item at once.

navigation.trigger: Another link becomes the current page (a client side route change, or a click in the stage).
navigation.feedback: The current mark (the bar under a Navbar link, the edge bar of a Sidebar or Rail item, each the item ::before) slides from the old current item along the bar or the column and stretches on the way. The Sidebar label and the Rail icon of the new item pop, the old one dips. The item fill and weight change at once. Two items marked current at once do not slide between each other.
beats: Action: the pill moves from the box of the item it leaves to the box of the item it reaches on ease.spring-snappy over duration.spring-snappy (Neutral 180ms, Desk 300ms with a 10% overshoot, Studio 80ms in two steps). The new state is set at once; the pill only draws the way.
Stretch: halfway the pill is longer along its travel by up to scale.stretch (Neutral 1.15, Desk 1.3, Studio 1.08), less for a short hop, then settles to its own size.

Secondary: the label it leaves dips to scale.anticipate and back on ease.out over duration.spring-soft; the label it reaches pops from scale.anticipate past rest on ease.spring-bouncy over duration.spring-bouncy (Neutral 220ms, Desk 440ms, Studio 120ms).
A second change mid travel starts from where the pill is drawn, not from where it was headed.

styles.studio: two hard steps, a short stretch
styles.desk: a long slide that passes the item and swings back
styles.neutral: a quick slide that lands with no visible swing

navigation.reduced: No motion: the bar appears on the new item at once.

navigation.trigger: Move the pointer from one step, link or item to the next.
navigation.feedback: The hover pill (Breadcrumbs: a new pill on the link ::before; Navbar, Sidebar and Rail: their hover veil) fades in on hover, and when the pointer came from a neighbour within duration.slow it slides from that neighbour and stretches, so one pill seems to follow the pointer. In Breadcrumbs the separator after the hovered step nudges toward the next step by distance.nudge on the snappy spring (CSS). Touch does nothing.
beats: Action: the pill fades in over duration.fast (CSS) while it slides from the neighbour on ease.spring-snappy over duration.spring-snappy (Neutral 180ms, Desk 300ms, Studio 80ms in two steps).
Stretch: halfway it is longer along the travel by up to scale.stretch.
Secondary: the Breadcrumbs separator leans toward the next step by distance.nudge (Neutral 2px, Desk 3px, Studio 1px) on the snappy spring, and back when the pointer leaves.

styles.studio: a stepped hop and a 1px lean
styles.desk: a long follow with a swing and a 3px lean
styles.neutral: a quick follow and a 2px lean

navigation.reduced: The pill fades in place; nothing slides and the separator stays still.

navigation.trigger: Press a page number, previous, next, first or last.
navigation.feedback: The page changes at once. The pressed arrow winds up: its icon draws back by distance.nudge and goes forward by distance.shift, then home. Each page slot whose number changed rolls digit by digit (rollDigits, up for a later page, down for an earlier one) in an aria-hidden host; the page keeps its aria-label. The current fill (an aria-hidden span inside the page part) slides to the new current slot when it moves, and the number it reaches pops.
beats: Anticipation: the arrow icon draws back by distance.nudge (Neutral 2px, Desk 3px, Studio 1px) in the first quarter, against its direction.
Action: the page changes on the click; the icon goes forward by distance.shift and home on ease.out over duration.spring-bouncy (Neutral 220ms, Desk 440ms, Studio 120ms).
Secondary: the numbers that changed roll one column at a time from the last digit, delay.stagger apart (Neutral 24ms, Desk 45ms, Studio 0ms), on ease.spring-snappy over duration.spring-snappy.
Overshoot and settle: the current fill slides with the shared pill when its slot moves (the first and the last pages), and the number it reaches pops on the bouncy spring.

styles.studio: digits fade in place (its number-roll preset is reduced), the arrow ticks 1px
styles.desk: digits roll with a swing, the arrow winds up 3px
styles.neutral: a quick roll and a small wind up

navigation.reduced: The new numbers fade in; nothing travels.

navigation.trigger: Collapse or expand the Sidebar with its toggle; show or hide the Rail labels (hideLabels).
navigation.feedback: The width and the hidden labels change at once (only transform and opacity may move). On expand the labels, counts and group titles come in from the inline start two stagger steps after the panel, one step apart (staggerGroup). On collapse the icons gather from scale.anticipate and settle. In the Rail the icons travel to their new places (flipPlay) and the labels rise in after them.
beats: Action: the panel takes its new width at once.

Secondary, expand: after two stagger steps the labels slide in from the inline start by distance.shift and fade in on ease.spring-soft over duration.spring-soft (Neutral 220ms, Desk 340ms, Studio 100ms), delay.stagger apart, capped at six.
Secondary, collapse: the icons pop from scale.anticipate past rest on the bouncy spring. Rail: the icons travel on the snappy spring.

styles.desk: labels ripple in one by one

navigation.reduced: The labels fade in with no travel and no delay; the icons do not move.

navigation.trigger: Move to another step (next, back, or a reachable step title).
navigation.feedback: A ring (the indicator ::after, drawn only while it travels) slides from the old current indicator to the new one in the direction of the change, stretches along the way and fades as it lands. The new current indicator pops. The connector fill grows or shrinks on the soft spring (CSS, Stepper.css).
beats: Action: the ring travels on ease.spring-snappy over duration.spring-snappy (Neutral 180ms, Desk 300ms, Studio 80ms), stretched by up to scale.stretch, from opacity 1 to 0 as it lands.
Overshoot and settle: the new current indicator pops from scale.anticipate on the bouncy spring.
Secondary: the connector after a step that turns complete fills on ease.spring-soft over duration.spring-soft; going back it empties the same way.

styles.desk: a long travel and a swinging pop

navigation.reduced: Nothing travels; the current step and the fill change at once.

navigation.trigger: Scroll to another section, or choose a link.
navigation.feedback: The bar beside the active link moves on the snappy spring (a CSS transition) and stretches along its travel with its trailing edge still, so it leans in the direction of the change (a WAAPI stretch added to the transition).
beats: Action: the bar travels on ease.spring-snappy over duration.spring-snappy (Neutral 180ms, Desk 300ms with a 10% overshoot, Studio 80ms in two steps).
Stretch: it grows to scale.stretch from its trailing edge at 40% of the move and settles on ease.standard.

styles.desk: a long move that passes the link and swings back

navigation.reduced: The bar jumps to the active link.

navigation.trigger: A destination becomes current (or the bar mounts on a new page).
navigation.feedback: The icon and its pill pop from scale.anticipate past rest and settle; the label rises by distance.nudge a stagger step later. Colors and weight change at once.
beats: Overshoot and settle: the icon box pops on ease.spring-bouncy over duration.spring-bouncy (Neutral 220ms with a 6% overshoot, Desk 440ms with 25%, Studio 120ms in three steps).
Secondary: the label rises by distance.nudge on the same spring, delay.stagger later.

styles.studio: no pop: its pop preset is reduced, so the recipe sets the duration to 0ms
styles.desk: a big bouncy pop

navigation.trigger: Hover a tile or focus it; an item becomes current.
navigation.feedback: The hovered tile lifts toward the pointer by --_dock-lift and grows to --_dock-scale on the bouncy spring; the next tile on each side follows at half the lift, the one after at a quarter. The current tile pops when it becomes current.
beats: Action: the tile lifts (base distance.lift and scale.lift; Desk magnifies to 1.25 and lifts space.xs) on ease.spring-bouncy over duration.spring-bouncy (Neutral 220ms, Desk 440ms with a 25% overshoot, Studio 120ms).
Secondary: the neighbours lift by half and a quarter, so the row swells around the pointer.
Overshoot and settle: a tile that becomes current pops from scale.anticipate past rest, added to its hover transform.

styles.studio: no lift and no pop (its lift tokens are 0 and its pop preset is reduced)
styles.desk: the magnify with a swing; neighbours swell
styles.neutral: a 2px lift and a small pop

navigation.reduced: No lift, no magnify, no pop.

navigation.trigger: Press a toolbar item; turn a toggle item on.
navigation.feedback: On top of Button's press, a pressed item dips its parts to scale.anticipate (Button's --_button-part-press) and springs back on release. A toggle item that turns on pops its icon from scale.anticipate past rest.
beats: Anticipation: the item dips to scale.press and its icon gathers to scale.anticipate while held (duration.instant).
Overshoot and settle: on release both spring back on ease.spring-bouncy over duration.spring-bouncy (Neutral 220ms, Desk 440ms, Studio 120ms).
Secondary: an item that turns on pops its icon on the same spring.

styles.desk: a deep gather and a swinging release

navigation.reduced: No scale; the on fill carries the state.

navigation.trigger: The current language changes in place (a client side switch).
navigation.feedback: The menu trigger rolls its name: the old name rolls up and out in an aria-hidden copy while the new one rolls in from below. In the link pair the name it leaves dips and the name it reaches pops.
beats: Action: both names roll a full line on ease.spring-snappy over duration.spring-snappy (Neutral 180ms, Desk 300ms, Studio 80ms in two steps), fading as they go.
Secondary, the pair: the leaving name dips to scale.anticipate, the reached name pops past rest on the bouncy spring.

styles.desk: a roll with a swing

navigation.feedback: The link is drawn at once with its focus ring, and slides down into place from distance.enter above, passing its place and settling. The ring never fades or scales.
beats: Action: drawn at once, ring included.
Overshoot and settle: it slides by distance.enter (Neutral 6px, Desk 12px, Studio 4px) on ease.spring-bouncy over duration.spring-bouncy (Neutral 220ms, Desk 440ms, Studio 120ms in three steps).

styles.desk: a long drop with a bounce

feedback.trigger: An Alert, a Banner or a Callout mounts.
feedback.feedback: Three beats: the surface arrives, the icon pops one stagger step later, the text settles two steps later. A Callout only fades its box, so the text column of a page never jumps.
beats: Action: the surface fades in while it rises distance.enter (an Alert from below, a Banner from above) and an Alert grows from scale.enter, on ease.spring-soft over duration.spring-soft (Neutral 220ms, Desk 340ms with a small overshoot, Studio 100ms in steps).

Overshoot: one delay.stagger later (24, 45, 0ms) the icon pops from scale.morph (0.5, 0.3, 0.8) on ease.spring-bouncy over duration.spring-bouncy (220ms, 440ms with a 25% overshoot, 120ms in steps), landing past its size and settling.
Settle: two steps later the title, the body and the actions rise distance.nudge (2, 3, 1px) and fade in on the soft spring.

styles.studio: hard cuts, every part at once
styles.desk: a bouncy icon, a long settle
styles.neutral: a quick rise, a small icon pop

feedback.reduced: No motion: the message is there at once.

feedback.trigger: Press the close button of an Alert or a Banner.
feedback.feedback: onClose runs at once and the message leaves the DOM. Before the next paint a decorative ghost of it shrinks to scale.enter and fades, faster than the entrance, while the content under it slides up into the gap.
beats: Action: the ghost (aria-hidden, inert) shrinks to scale.enter and fades on ease.exit over duration.quick (100ms in every style), about half the entrance (flipExit).
Secondary: the neighbours that moved travel from their old place on ease.spring-snappy over duration.spring-snappy (180, 300, 80ms; flipPlay), so the page closes the gap instead of jumping.

styles.studio: a fast fade, the gap closes in steps
styles.desk: the page below springs up with an overshoot
styles.neutral: a quick shrink, a short slide

feedback.reduced: A fade of the ghost; the content below takes its place at once.

feedback.trigger: An EmptyState or an ErrorState mounts (a list emptied by a filter, a section that failed).
feedback.feedback: The icon settles from a small lift, then the title, the body and the actions follow one stagger step apart.
beats: Action: the icon falls from distance.lift above (2, 4, 0px) and grows from scale.enter (0.97, 0.9, 1) while it fades in, on ease.spring-bouncy over duration.spring-bouncy, so it lands with an overshoot in Desk.
Stagger: the title, the body, the actions (and the details of an ErrorState) rise distance.nudge and fade in on the soft spring, one delay.stagger apart starting one step after the icon.

styles.studio: all parts at once, in steps
styles.desk: the icon drops in and bounces, a slow cascade
styles.neutral: a light settle and a 24ms cascade

feedback.reduced: No motion: every part is there at once.

feedback.trigger: Open or close the details of an ErrorState.
feedback.feedback: The chevron turns half a turn on the snappy spring; the details show at once.
beats: Action and overshoot: the chevron turns 180 degrees on ease.spring-snappy over duration.spring-snappy (180, 300, 80ms), past its angle in Desk, then settles.

styles.desk: a turn that swings past and back

feedback.reduced: No motion: the chevron points the new way at once.

feedback.trigger: Open a section with its header button, Enter or Space.
feedback.feedback: The section takes its open height at once and clips; its content slides down from above the clip and fades in, then its paragraphs and lists settle one after another; the chevron turns on a spring. Closing is at once.
beats: Action: the content layer slides from -100% of its own height and fades in, opaque at 60%, over duration.slow on ease.standard. A panel does not overshoot. The height never animates and the text never scales.
Secondary: the chevron turns 180 degrees on ease.spring-snappy over duration.spring-snappy, past its angle in Desk.

Stagger: each element child of the content rises distance.nudge and fades in on ease.spring-soft, one delay.stagger apart, capped at six steps. Plain text content has no children, so only the layer slides.

styles.studio: a stepped turn, every child at once
styles.desk: a swinging chevron and a 45ms cascade
styles.neutral: a quick turn and a 24ms cascade

feedback.reduced: No motion: the content shows at once and the chevron points the new way at once.

feedback.trigger: A skeleton shows while its content loads, then the content replaces it.
feedback.feedback: A band sweeps across the placeholder toward the inline end three times and stops before five seconds. When the content replaces it, the skeleton cross fades into the content.
beats: Loop: the band sweeps linear over duration.shimmer, three times (4.2s), then the placeholder holds still, so it needs no pause control.

Cross fade: the skeleton leaves the DOM at once; a decorative ghost of it, put back where it was drawn, fades out over duration.morph (200, 320, 100ms) on ease.exit on top of the content that took its place.

styles.desk: a slow dissolve

feedback.reduced: No motion: the band is not drawn and the content replaces the placeholder at once.

feedback.trigger: The number of a Stat changes after it first paints.
feedback.feedback: The number rolls digit by digit, the last digit first, up when it grew and down when it fell; unchanged digits stay still; the trend mark nudges the same way. No number rolls more than three times a second.
beats: Action: each changed digit rolls in its own column, 100% of its height, on ease.spring-snappy over duration.spring-snappy (180, 300, 80ms), the old digit rolling out the other way (rollDigits).
Stagger: the columns start one delay.stagger apart from the last digit toward the first, so a carry ripples like an odometer.
Secondary: one step after the digits start, the trend mark nudges distance.nudge in the direction of the change and comes back, over duration.spring-bouncy.
Limit: a change less than 333ms (or one roll, if longer) after the last roll changes in place, so a fast counter changes at most three times a second in every style.

styles.studio: a fade of the new digits (the number-roll pattern is reduced in Studio)
styles.desk: a long odometer roll

feedback.reduced: The changed digits fade in, with no travel and no nudge.

feedback.trigger: A toast is shown, or closed by its timer, its close button or Escape.
feedback.feedback: The new toast springs in from the edge of the toaster and its icon pops a beat later; a closing toast fades and shrinks faster than it came.
beats: Action: the toast travels space.xs in from the edge and grows from scale.enter while it fades in, on ease.spring-bouncy over duration.spring-bouncy, landing past its place in Desk.
Overshoot: one delay.stagger later the icon pops from scale.morph on the bouncy spring and settles.
Exit: a closing toast fades and shrinks to scale.enter over duration.toast-exit on ease.exit, faster than the entrance.

styles.studio: a stepped arrival, icon with the card
styles.desk: a springy arrival and a bouncing icon
styles.neutral: a short spring, a small pop

feedback.reduced: No motion: the toast is there and gone at once.

feedback.trigger: A toast joins the stack or leaves it while other toasts are shown.
feedback.feedback: The toasts that stay move from where they were to their new place with a transform on a spring (flipPlay). Layout never animates and the store never waits; the pause on hover and focus is kept.
beats: Secondary: each toast that has to make room travels from its old place on ease.spring-snappy over duration.spring-snappy (180, 300, 80ms), past its place in Desk; a move still in flight starts from where the toast is drawn.

styles.desk: springy room making

feedback.reduced: No motion: the toasts that stay take their new place at once.

feedback.trigger: Drag a toast toward the edge it sits on, then let go.
feedback.feedback: While dragged the toast follows the finger. Let go short of the threshold it springs back on the snappy spring; past it, it travels on out in the swipe direction while it fades.
beats: Action: the toast follows the finger (the Radix swipe variables, no transition).
Settle: let go short, it springs back on ease.spring-snappy over duration.spring-snappy; past the threshold it travels on out over duration.toast-exit on ease.exit.

styles.desk: a return that swings past its place

feedback.reduced: The toast still follows the finger. Let go, it is back in place at once, or it is gone where it was let go.

feedback.trigger: A notification is added or removed, or the unread count changes.
feedback.feedback: New entries pop in, removed entries shrink away, the rest slide to their new place, and the unread count rolls and pops.
beats: Action: a new entry rises distance.shift and grows from scale.enter while it fades in, on ease.spring-bouncy over duration.spring-bouncy; several new entries start one delay.stagger apart (flipPlay enter).
Exit: a removed entry comes back as a ghost that shrinks to scale.enter and fades over duration.quick (flipExit).
Secondary: the entries and group labels that stay travel from their old place on the snappy spring.
Secondary: the number in the unread count rolls digit by digit (rollDigits; the words stay whole) and the count pill pops to scale.pop over duration.celebrate.

styles.desk: bouncy entries and a big pop
styles.neutral: short slides and a small pop

feedback.reduced: New entries fade in; the rest take their place at once; the new count fades in.

feedback.trigger: The value of a ProgressBar or a ProgressCircle changes.
feedback.feedback: A bar eases its fill to the new value on the soft spring. A ring turns its new arc into place on the soft spring (the nearest transform form of a sweep) while its value rolls digit by digit.
beats: Action: the bar fill scales on the inline axis on ease.spring-soft over duration.spring-soft (220, 340, 100ms), landing a little past the value in Desk.
Action: the ring arc starts turned back by the change and turns into place on the soft spring, so its leading end sweeps forward from the old value.
Secondary: the value inside the ring rolls digit by digit (rollDigits).

styles.desk: a fill that overshoots a little

feedback.reduced: No motion: the new value shows at once.

feedback.trigger: The value reaches max after being below it (once per completion, never on a first paint at max).
feedback.feedback: The bar track dips and pops on the block axis; the ring dips and pops. Once.
beats: Anticipation: a dip to scale.anticipate (0.95, 0.9, 0.97) in the first fifth.
Overshoot: a pop to scale.pop (1.05, 1.14, 1) at about half, then rest, over duration.celebrate (220, 480, 120ms) on ease.out.

styles.desk: a big, slow pop

feedback.reduced: No motion: the bar or ring reads done at once.

feedback.trigger: A Meter is first seen: at mount when it is on screen, else when it scrolls into view.
feedback.feedback: The fill grows from the inline start to the value once, on the soft spring curve stretched over duration.reveal. Later value changes ease on the soft spring.
beats: Hold: until it is seen, an inline scaleX(0) holds the fill empty (set before the first paint, so a meter in view never shows full first); no animation waits paused.
Action: the hold is dropped and the fill transitions from 0 to the value on ease.spring-soft over duration.reveal (640ms), landing a little past the value in Desk; once per mount.

styles.desk: a fill that overshoots and settles

feedback.reduced: No motion: the value shows at once.

feedback.trigger: The status of an Avatar changes after it first paints (away to online, for example).
feedback.feedback: The status dot pops and a ring in the status color grows out of it and fades, three times, then stops by itself.
beats: Overshoot: the dot dips to scale.anticipate and pops to scale.pop over duration.celebrate.
Loop: a ring grows from the dot to 2.5 times its size while it fades, over duration.pulse (1.4s), three times (4.2s), so it ends before five seconds; pauseLoops() also pauses it.

styles.desk: a big pop and pulse

feedback.reduced: No motion: the new status shape shows at once. A first paint never pulses.

feedback.trigger: A StatusDot with pulse shows a live state (syncing, recording).
feedback.feedback: Each loop the dot beats (a dip and a pop) while a ring grows out of it and fades; three loops, then it stops by itself.
beats: Anticipation and overshoot: in the first third of each loop the dot dips to scale.anticipate and pops to scale.pop, then rests.
Secondary: a ring grows from the dot to 2.5 times and fades over the whole loop, duration.pulse on ease.out.
Limit: three loops (4.2s at 1.4s) set by --_status-dot-loops, under five seconds (WCAG 2.2.2), and under three flashes a second.

styles.studio: a ring only (pop is 1 in Studio)
styles.desk: a strong beat

feedback.reduced: No motion: a still dot with its label.

feedback.trigger: An avatar joins or leaves an AvatarGroup, or the overflow count changes.
feedback.feedback: A new avatar pops in, a removed one shrinks away, the rest slide over, and the overflow count rolls and pops.
beats: Action: a new avatar rises distance.shift and grows from scale.enter on ease.spring-bouncy (flipPlay enter); a removed one comes back as a ghost that shrinks away over duration.quick.
Secondary: the avatars and the overflow that stay slide to their new place on ease.spring-snappy over duration.spring-snappy.
Secondary: the overflow number rolls digit by digit and the overflow pops to scale.pop over duration.celebrate.

styles.desk: bouncy arrivals

feedback.reduced: New avatars fade in; the rest take their place at once; the count fades.

feedback.trigger: The count of a Badge changes after it first paints.
feedback.feedback: The digits roll up or down and the badge dips and pops; a dot badge only pops.
beats: Action: the changed digits roll in their columns on ease.spring-snappy (rollDigits), last digit first.
Overshoot: the badge dips to scale.anticipate and pops to scale.pop over duration.celebrate. A badge placed with a transform of its own pops its label instead, so it stays where it is.

styles.studio: a fade of the digits, no pop
styles.desk: a long roll and a big pop
styles.neutral: a quick roll and a small pop

feedback.reduced: The new digits fade in; no pop.

feedback.trigger: Move the pointer over an interactive Card or Tile (one with a CardLink or a TileLink).
feedback.feedback: The card rises and grows a little on a spring, and a soft highlight inside it follows the pointer.
beats: Action: the card rises distance.lift (2, 4, 0px) and grows to scale.lift (1.01, 1.03, 1) on ease.spring-soft over duration.spring-soft; the hit area moves at most a few pixels.
Secondary: a soft round highlight on a decorative span inside the card fades in over duration.moderate and follows the pointer by transform. The span is aria-hidden and takes no pointer.

styles.studio: no lift, only the highlight and the tone
styles.desk: a 4px lift with an overshoot

feedback.reduced: No motion: the card changes tone only and no highlight is drawn.

feedback.trigger: A Spinner mounts while something loads.
feedback.feedback: The spinner fades in, then turns in an endless linear loop that pauseLoops() can pause (WCAG 2.2.2).
beats: Action: the ring fades in over duration.spring-soft on ease.out, so a short wait does not blink.
Loop: the ring turns once per duration.spin, linear, until the spinner unmounts or pauseLoops() pauses it.

styles.desk: a 340ms fade

feedback.reduced: No motion: a still ring with its arc; the label still says what is busy.

feedback.trigger: Press on the keyboard a key that a Kbd keycap names.
feedback.feedback: That keycap goes down while the key is held and springs back up on release; a shortcut presses key by key.
beats: Action: the keycap dips distance.nudge and to scale.anticipate on ease.spring-snappy over duration.spring-snappy, and holds.
Settle: on release it springs back on ease.spring-bouncy over duration.spring-bouncy, past its rest in Desk.

styles.desk: a deep press and a bounce

feedback.reduced: No motion: the keycap stays still.

feedback.trigger: Hover, focus or drag the handle between two panels.
feedback.feedback: The grip fades in and grows along the line on a spring; while dragged it stretches and springs back on release.
beats: Action: the grip grows along the line from scale.morph to its length on ease.spring-bouncy over duration.spring-bouncy while it fades in.
Secondary: while the handle is dragged the grip stretches to scale.stretch (1.15, 1.3, 1.08) and springs back when it is let go.

styles.desk: a bouncy grow and a long stretch

feedback.reduced: No motion: the grip shows at its length at once and does not stretch.

feedback.trigger: Open a detail, or go back to the list, while a SplitView is stacked.
feedback.feedback: The pane that shows slides in from the side it comes from: the detail from the inline end, the list from the inline start. The switch is at once.
beats: Action: the pane slides distance.enter (6, 12, 4px) on ease.spring-soft over duration.spring-soft. Transform only, no fade: focus moves into the pane and its ring shows at once.

styles.desk: a 12px slide with a settle

feedback.reduced: No motion: the pane is there at once.
